reasons.requirements: All seven acceptance criteria are covered by the spec and the diff, including null-clearing, impossible dates, the UTC overdue rule and the 'überfällig' and 'nur überfällige' labels.
reasons.scope: The code changes are tightly scoped; the only extras are the plan and spec markdown files added to the repo.
reasons.tests: API tests cover valid, invalid, set, clear and overdue-filter cases, and the one changed existing assertion only adds dueDate: null. The new UI (marker, toggle, date format) has no automated test, only a manual Playwright run.
reasons.conventions: It uses ValidationError for 400s, Node builtins only, the existing test helpers, and data-testid on every new UI element, as AGENTS.md requires.
reasons.architecture: Validation and filtering live in the store and the route only passes the query flag through. The overdue rule is duplicated in the UI, but the spec explicitly allows client-side filtering.
reasons.codeQuality: The code is clear and handles the edge cases (impossible dates, non-string values, null clearing). Minor nits: the NaN check is redundant, the date is parsed twice, and the UI hides items with inline styles.
